name: handoff-memory
abstract: Agent-neutral workflow for creating, refreshing, validating, and resuming shared handoff and memory documents for a repository, workspace, or workstream. Keeps the runtime entrypoint compact through task-based reference routing while preserving canonical Git-trackable files, ambiguity-safe resume targeting, actionable HANDOFF-only length diagnostics, optional snapshots, and an availability-gated durable-history follow-up that never becomes a runtime dependency.
